name: application-kbd
title: Kbd
description: Inline keyboard-shortcut hints and a shortcuts list panel, built on the native <kbd> element for a button trigger and an action/shortcut reference list.
useWhen: Showing a keyboard shortcut hint inline next to a button or menu item.
Building a shortcuts reference panel that pairs an action label with its key combination.
You want semantic <kbd> markup rather than styled <span> or <div> elements for key glyphs.
avoidWhen: You only need a single bare key glyph with no surrounding layout — use the building-blocks Keycap primitive directly instead.
The shortcuts need to be searchable or filterable — pair this with a search input rather than extending it.
responsiveBehavior: The shortcuts list is a single-column stack at all widths; the trigger button and its shortcut hint wrap together as one inline unit.
accessibility: Key glyphs use the native <kbd> element so assistive technology recognizes them as keyboard input.
The shortcuts panel is a real list (<ul>/<li>) so screen readers announce the item count and position.
Symbol glyphs (⌘, ↑, ↓) are visual shorthand; pair with a text label in the same row so the shortcut is understandable without relying on the symbol alone.

variants.title: Kbd
variants.description: A trigger button with an inline ⌘S hint, and a four-row keyboard shortcuts list panel.
accessibility: Each row pairs a text label with its <kbd> keys so the shortcut is never conveyed by symbol alone.

variants.title: Kbd (Dark)
variants.description: The trigger button and shortcuts list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Key glyph borders and shadows remain visible against the dark surface.
